Most business owners have the desire or need to automate repetitive tasks and eliminate redundant tasks, freeing employees to concentrate on delighting customers, generating ideas, or performing activities that promote innovation and business growth. This applies to both small business owners and large enterprises alike.

One way of doing this is through business automation, which enables organisations to [automate business processes](https://www.claromentis.com/enablement-hub/business-process-automation) and complex workflows.

## **What is a workflow?**

A workflow is a sequence of steps laying out the operations, resources, and personnel required to implement various business processes.

[Workflows](https://www.claromentis.com/enablement-hub/business-process-automation) provide a framework that enables a business to organise work in such a way as to minimise manual tasks and repetitive processes, thereby increasing efficiency, promoting more seamless communication between stakeholders, and freeing employees to perform more high value tasks.

[Learn more about Workflow Automation](https://info.claromentis.com/cs/c/?cta_guid=7f18dcae-d739-4189-a13a-406b295ed0a0&signature=AAH58kH5LCbpF4CNQukz-VSrPOFgORDpag&portal_id=5025095&placement_guid=220cea21-9eb1-438e-a261-c4dd89ddd908&canon=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.claromentis.com%2Fblog%2Fworkflow-automation-for-small-businesses%2F&ts=1727181548134 "Learn more about Workflow Automation")

 

## **How do small businesses manage workflows?**

Small business workflows cover a range of activities and business processes. For example, if you’re a small business owner who deals directly with consumers, one of the tasks you may need to create custom workflows for is Customer Support. Here, your workflow management tasks may include facilitating [seamless communication](https://www.claromentis.com/applications/collaboration) between your marketing team, sales reps, and support staff, and providing easy access to customer information from your Customer Relationship management or CRM tool, to save each support employee’s time in moving cases from initial contact to resolution.

Even this simple example illustrates that small business owners must occasionally deal with complex workflows that consist of many moving parts. Organising these various workflow processes takes a degree of planning. A general procedure for designing workflows for small businesses takes the following form:

### **1\. Design the layout for the workflow**

![Design the layout for the workflow](https://www.claromentis.com/hs-fs/hubfs/Imported_Blog_Media/Design-the-layout-for-the-workflow-1024x667-1.png?width=1024&height=667&name=Design-the-layout-for-the-workflow-1024x667-1.png)

Decide what tasks need to be done, the processes that are involved, and what resources, staff, and time periods that each process takes. This design stage can be greatly simplified by using [workflow automation software](https://www.claromentis.com/enablement-hub/business-process-automation).

Workflow software will typically include a form design tool with templates that provide pre-designed fields and workflows that you can customise to automate repetitive tasks, without needing coding knowledge.

### **2\. Apply relevant business rules**

![Apply relevant business rules](https://www.claromentis.com/hs-fs/hubfs/Imported_Blog_Media/Apply-relevant-business-rules-1024x438-1.png?width=1024&height=438&name=Apply-relevant-business-rules-1024x438-1.png)

Using business logic relevant to each stage of the workflow, you can create custom rules to speed up your business processes. These rules might, for example, eliminate manual data entry to minimise human error, or configure the automation software to automate repetitive tasks, reducing the labour burden on your workers, and leaving happy employees free to contribute more actively to the small business. 

### **3\. Configure and implement the workflow**

Performing a few test runs of your workflows will help in establishing whether all the necessary processes are in place, and in the right order. Workflow management software may include monitoring and evaluation tools to assist in this assessment, while workflow automation software should provide features for tweaking the workflow elements to achieve optimal performance.

[Learn more about Workflow Automation](https://info.claromentis.com/cs/c/?cta_guid=7f18dcae-d739-4189-a13a-406b295ed0a0&signature=AAH58kH5LCbpF4CNQukz-VSrPOFgORDpag&portal_id=5025095&placement_guid=220cea21-9eb1-438e-a261-c4dd89ddd

Most teams don't have a productivity problem. They have a repetition problem.

Status updates, approval routing, handoff messages: all of that is time your team spends on work that shouldn't require a person. [Workflow automation](https://www.atlassian.com/agile/project-management/workflow-automation) software fixes this by replacing manual, rule-based tasks with triggers and actions that run in the background.

With [Agile project management](https://www.atlassian.com/agile/project-management) features, modern workflow automation tools are no longer just about moving data; they are about intelligent decision-making. Whether you need automation software to handle simple triggers or complex AI-driven processes, the right tools can eliminate repetitive tasks and let your team focus on high-impact work. 

This guide covers nine of the best workflow automation tools available in 2026, what each one does well, and how to choose the right one for your team.

## What are workflow automation software tools?

Workflow automation software tools are platforms that use rule-based logic (triggers, conditions, and actions) to automate repetitive manual tasks. When a trigger fires (a form is submitted, a status changes, a deadline passes), the system executes a defined sequence of steps automatically. These tools connect different applications to streamline business processes, reduce human error, and increase overall team productivity.

Rule-based automation handles the "if this, then that" layer. Modern platforms add an [AI workflow automation](https://www.atlassian.com/agile/project-management/ai-workflow-automation) layer on top: agents that can interpret context, make routing decisions, and take actions that a fixed rule never could.

## Benefits of workflow automation software

Workflow automation streamlines business processes by reducing manual effort and minimizing human error. This is crucial if you need more efficient and reliable operations.

By automating repetitive tasks, teams can focus on higher-value work and collaborate more effectively across departments. Here are a few more key benefits to automation software:

*   **Fewer mistakes:** Automation ensures tasks are executed consistently and accurately.
    
*   **Focus on more complex tasks:** By automating routine and repetitive work, employees spend time on the most impactful work.
    
*   **Improved cross-functional collaboration:** Through centralized communication and information-sharing platforms, teams work together—not in silos.
    
*   **Faster decision-making:** This helps businesses speed up seamless information exchanges and shared communication channels.
    
*   **Easier scalability:** As processes are optimized, automated workflows handle increased workloads and reduce manual effort.
